name: Tebah
title: Son of Nahor and Reumah
summary: Tebah was the firstborn son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by his concubine Reumah. He is briefly mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis 22. Tebah is primarily known as part of Abraham's extended family and as an ancestor of a clan in the Mesopotamia region.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Tebah is mentioned in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: After the account of Abraham's near-sacrifice of Isaac, Abraham was told that his brother Nahor had sons, including Tebah by the concubine Reumah.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Nahor
keyEvents.description: Tebah is the first of four sons born to Reumah, Nahor's concubine. These sons represented clans in the Mesopotamian region.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's family relationships
keyEvents.description: Tebah's connection to Abraham's lineage illustrates the broader family network the patriarchs belonged to, with ties stretching back to Ur of the Chaldees and Haran.

keyEvents.title: The context for Tebah's mention
keyEvents.description: The news of Nahor's sons, including Tebah, reached Abraham right after the dramatic event on Mount Moriah, where Abraham demonstrated his faith by being willing to sacrifice Isaac.
